gaps.next_text: I look to a future full of hope and glory

gaps.prev_text: but the shrewd plans of a seasoned ruler.
gaps.next_text: For now even the prophecies align with us

cues.text: A horned silhouette raises a glowing staff.
Massive glowing lines form in the mist.
The lines coalesce into a towering, spectral entity that dwarfs the figure on the stairs. The massive, glowing crest dominates the cavern, then fades into darkness.

beats.note: A silhouetted, horned Nakalim figure stands at the top of a dark stone staircase, holding a staff with a glowing green tip. The background is a vast cavern filled with swirling green mist.
The camera slowly pulls back. The green mist continues to swirl behind the figure.
Faint glowing lines begin to emerge in the green mist behind the figure.
The lines become more distinct, tracing the outline of a massive shape.
The shape reveals itself as a towering, ethereal entity or crest, glowing brightly.
The massive spectral entity is fully formed, dwarfing the figure on the stairs.
The scene begins to fade out.
